subject: Vendr onboarding — evidence runbook & presign checkpoint
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@cleartrail.com>, security@cleartrail.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr onboarding — evidence runbook & presign checkpoint

Hi Jacob / ClearTrail security team,

Thanks for working with us on the Vendr onboarding. To keep the intake fast and auditable, we put together a short "live runbook" for the evidence handoff and presign flow. Can you confirm who on your side will: (1) accept the Vendr invite, (2) upload SOC2 artifact PDFs, and (3) confirm presign URLs for S3 objects?

Attached is a manifest template (vendr_manifest.csv) and a short presign instructions file. Our ask for a first pass: upload the SOC2 summary and the manifest by EOD Tue, Jan 16 so we can validate ownership and set the profile to "ready for review." If you prefer a short 20-minute walkthrough instead of doing the upload, we can run that on Monday morning PT.

Notes / quick checklist:
- Required: SOC2 summary (control mapping preferred), AOC if available.
- Helpful: service account email for temp presigns, sample S3 key path.
- We will not request full logs or PII during onboarding — only attestations and high-level artifacts.

Thanks — looping Kimberly and Marissa to help with the manifest and presign coordination.

Best,
Rafael
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendr_manifest.csv (csv), presign_instructions.txt (txt)

From: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@cleartrail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@cleartrail.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — evidence runbook & presign checkpoint

Hi Rafael — thanks for the clear checklist. I can take point for ClearTrail. A few quick clarifications before we start the upload:

1) For the SOC2 summary: do you want the full AOC or is the one-page control-summary sufficient for the initial profile?
2) Presigns: our infra team prefers we provide a service account; do you have a template for the required IAM policy?
3) Timezone: Monday morning PT works for us (we can do 8:30am PT).

If the answers are quick I can get the SOC2 condensed summary uploaded today and schedule the walkthrough for Monday.

— Jacob
Security Operations, ClearTrail

On Thu, Jan 12, 2028 at 09:14 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> (original message included)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@cleartrail.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — evidence runbook & presign checkpoint

Jacob — quick answers inline to help unblock uploads:

1) SOC2: start with the one-page control-summary + table of in-scope services. We'll mark the profile as "prelim ready" and ask for the full AOC later if needed for procurement.
2) Presign IAM: attached a short snippet (presign_instructions.txt) — minimum: s3:GetObject on the specific bucket prefix plus kms:Decrypt if objects are KMS-encrypted. If you want we can provide a minimal policy your infra team can paste into their role.
3) Walkthrough: Monday 8:30am PT works for me — invite sent (calendar).

I've also attached a filled example of the manifest so you can see required columns. If you upload to Vendr, please map the manifest columns to "artifact_type" and "control_reference" fields.

Kimberly
Security Enablement, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Summary.pdf (example), presign_instructions.txt (txt), vendr_manifest.csv (example)

From: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@cleartrail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@cleartrail.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jan 2028 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — evidence runbook & presign checkpoint

Thanks — uploaded the one-page SOC2 control summary to Vendr this morning and attached the manifest mapping in the Vendr upload (file name: vendr_manifest_cleartrail_20280116.csv). The service account we're using for presigns is: cleartrail-vendr-uploader@cleartrail-prod. We've granted the minimal role per your instructions — infra confirmed s3:GetObject and kms:Decrypt limited to the onboarding prefix.

Next steps from our side: confirm the profile shows "assets uploaded" on your side and share any missing control mappings.

— Jacob

On Thu, Jan 12, 2028 at 12:20 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> (Kimberly's presign snippet and example manifest attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@cleartrail.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — evidence runbook & presign checkpoint

Jacob — I see the uploads on Vendr and the manifest looks well-formed. Two small asks before we close the onboarding ticket:

1) Could you add the service account email as an "uploader" contact on the Vendr profile so the presign flow can be triggered from your side? (Vendr needs the email to tie presigns to the account.)
2) Please confirm whether the SOC2 summary maps to the "Data Protection" and "Access Control" controls — if so I can mark those as covered in the profile. If anything is mismatched, reply with the control_reference column value.

If both are done I'll mark the profile state as "ready for review" and we'll kick off the internal verification. We expect verification to take 2 business days.

Thanks — Marissa
Security Operations Coordinator, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Jacob Lin <jacob.lin@cleartrail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.inference.com>, security@cleartrail.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jan 2028 16:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding — evidence runbook & presign checkpoint

Marissa / team — confirmed. We've added cleartrail-vendr-uploader@cleartrail-prod as an uploader contact in Vendr, and the SOC2 summary covers Data Protection (CTL-3) and Access Control (CTL-1) per the manifest mapping. Please proceed with your verification. If you hit any missing items I'll be available on the verification call Thursday.

Appreciate the quick coordination — Jacob
Security Operations, ClearTrail Inc.
